rawFindings.title: Non-string post titles now break post creation
rawFindings.explanation: This line passes `data.slug || data.title` directly to `slugize`. `hexo-util`'s `slugize` operates on strings, and the previous conversion allowed numeric titles to be used as slugs. With this change, creating a post whose title is a number fails instead of producing the expected numeric slug/path.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore string coercion before calling `slugize`, e.g. `slugize((data.slug || data.title).toString(), ...)`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `post.create({title: 12345})` now throws/fails in `slugize` instead of creating `source/_posts/12345.md`.

rawFindings.title: Non-string draft slugs now break publishing
rawFindings.explanation: This line passes `data.slug` directly to `slugize`. Publishing previously accepted numeric slugs by coercing them to strings; now a numeric slug fails in `slugize` before the draft lookup can complete.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore string coercion before calling `slugize`, e.g. `slugize(data.slug.toString(), ...)`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With an existing draft named for numeric title/slug `12345`, calling `post.publish({slug: 12345})` now throws/fails in `slugize` instead of publishing to `source/_posts/12345.md`.
